semantic_summary: Test two equivalent scan-then-copy C forms for each observed inline far-string transfer. Target evidence scans the far source, then copies it to the 256-byte frame buffer; the append sequence scans wildcard source and current buffer before copying.
binding_evidence: Packet shows far selector Dx8 and offsets 0x94a0/0x9f10.
Target disassembly orders each NUL scan before its REP MOVSW/MOVSB transfer.

axes.name: initial_copy_loop_form
axes.rationale: Compare explicit indexed NUL-count then copy against pointer-walking NUL-count then copy; the observed target scans the far input and copies through its terminator.
values: i = 0; while (source[i] != 0) ++i; end = i; for (i = 0; i <= end; ++i) buffer[i] = source[i];
{ char far *scan = source; char near *dst = buffer; while (*scan != 0) { ++scan; ++dst; } end = (int)(scan - source); for (i = 0; i <= end; ++i) dst[i - end] = source[i]; }

axes.name: append_loop_form
axes.rationale: Compare explicit indexed and pointer-walking append forms; the target first measures the wildcard, then finds the destination terminator and copies wildcard plus NUL.
values: source = Dx8 + 0x9f10; i = 0; while (source[i] != 0) ++i; end = 0; while (buffer[end] != 0) ++end; for (last = 0; last <= i; ++last) buffer[end + last] = source[last];

source = Dx8 + 0x9f10; { char far *scan = source; char near *dst = buffer; while (*scan != 0) ++scan; i = (int)(scan - source); while (*dst != 0) ++dst; for (last = 0; last <= i; ++last) dst[last] = source[last]; }
